message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common tools, APIs, and platforms you can use to book flights—whether you’re building a travel app, automating a booking workflow, or just looking for the best way to find and reserve seats.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it offers | Typical use‑case |
|----------|----------------|----------------|-----------------|
| **Flight Search & Booking APIs** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Full flight search, booking, and ancillary services (seat selection, baggage, etc.). Includes a “Flight Offers Search” endpoint that returns price, availability, and booking links. | Enterprise travel apps, corporate booking portals. |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search for flights, hotels, car rentals. Provides price alerts and multi‑city itineraries. | Consumer travel sites, price‑comparison widgets. |
| | **Google Flights API (via Google Travel)** | (Limited public API) – You can embed Google Flights search results via the Google Travel SDK or use the unofficial “Google Flights” web scraper. | Integrate Google’s flight search UI into your site. |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Offers “Flights API” for searching, booking, and managing itineraries, including multi‑segment and “hidden‑city” tickets. | Niche travel agencies, price‑optimization tools. |
| | **Travelport Universal API** | Comprehensive travel content (flights, hotels, car rentals). Handles booking, ticketing, and itinerary management. | Large travel agencies, OTAs. |
| | **Expedia Rapid API** | Search and book flights, hotels, car rentals. Includes a “Flight Availability” endpoint. | Travel agencies, corporate booking portals. |
| | **Kayak API** | Search for flights, hotels, car rentals. Provides price comparison and booking links. | Price‑comparison sites, travel blogs. |
| | **CheapOair API** | Search and book flights, hotels, car rentals. Offers a “Flight Search” endpoint. | Travel agencies, coupon sites. |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data (positions, schedules). Not for booking but useful for flight status integration. | Flight tracking widgets, aviation analytics. |
| | **FlightAware API** | Flight status, delay info, historical data. | Status widgets, travel alerts. |
| | **SITA API** | Airline operational data (booking, check‑in, baggage). | Airline IT systems, B2B solutions. |
| | **Sabre API** | Extensive travel content, booking, and ticketing. | Enterprise travel portals, airline partners. |
| | **Travelpayouts API** | Affiliate flight search and booking. | Affiliate marketing, travel blogs. |
| | **Airline‑specific APIs** (e.g., Delta, United, Lufthansa) | Direct booking and ancillary services. | Airline‑direct booking portals, loyalty programs. |
| **Flight Search Engines (Web)** | **Google Flights** | Fast, intuitive UI; price alerts; multi‑city search. | End‑users looking for quick price comparisons. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Multi‑carrier search, price alerts, flexible dates. | End‑users, travel agencies. |
| | **Kayak** | Price comparison, “price forecast” feature. | End‑users, travel agencies. |
| | **Momondo** | Aggregates many carriers, shows price trends. | End‑users, travel agencies. |
| | **Expedia** | Full travel booking (flights, hotels, packages). | End‑users, corporate travel. |
| | **Orbitz** | Similar to Expedia, often bundled with hotel deals. | End‑users, corporate travel. |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price” and “Express Deals.” | End‑users, last‑minute deals. |
| | **CheapOair** | Focus on low‑fare flights, hotels, car rentals. | End‑users, travel agencies. |
| | **Trip.com** | Global coverage, especially strong in Asia. | End‑users, corporate travel. |
| | **Travelocity** | Similar to Expedia, often bundled with hotel deals. | End‑users, corporate travel. |
| | **Hotwire** | “Hot Rate” deals for flights and hotels. | End‑users, last‑minute deals. |
| | **Airfarewatchdog** | Price alerts, deals from multiple carriers. | End‑users, travel agencies. |
| | **Google Flights** | (See above) | End‑users. |
| **Flight Status & Tracking** | **FlightRadar24 API** | Real‑time flight tracking, status updates. | Travel apps, status widgets. |
| | **FlightAware API** | (See above) | Status widgets, alerts. |
| | **OpenSky API** | (See above) | Real‑time flight data. |
| **Booking Automation / Bots** | **Selenium + Python** | Automate web interactions with flight booking sites. | Testing, scraping (where allowed). |
| | **Puppeteer (Node.js)** | Headless Chrome automation. | Similar to Selenium. |
| | **Airline APIs** | Direct booking via airline’s own API. | Airline‑direct booking. |
| **Travel Aggregator Platforms** | **Travelpayouts** | Affiliate flight search, booking, and revenue sharing. | Affiliate marketing. |
| | **Skyscanner Affiliate** | Earn commissions on bookings made through your site. | Affiliate marketing. |
| | **Google Travel Affiliate** | (Limited) | Affiliate marketing. |
| **Other Useful Libraries / SDKs** | **Python‑Skyscanner** | Wrapper around Skyscanner API. | Quick prototyping. |
| | **Node‑Amadeus** | Node.js wrapper for Amadeus API. | Node.js projects. |
| | **Java‑Sabre** | Java SDK for Sabre. | Enterprise Java apps. |
| | **Ruby‑Travelport** | Ruby wrapper for Travelport. | Ruby on Rails travel apps. |

### How to Choose

| Factor | Recommendation |
|--------|----------------|
| **Scope** | If you need a full booking flow (search → seat selection → payment → ticket issuance), go with **Amadeus**, **Travelport**, or **Sabre**. |
| **Price** | For cost‑effective price comparison, use **Skyscanner**, **Kayak**, or **Google Flights**. |
| **Affiliate** | If you’re monetizing traffic, try **Travelpayouts** or **Skyscanner Affiliate**. |
| **Real‑time Status** | Use **FlightRadar24** or **FlightAware** for live flight data. |
| **Airline‑Specific** | For direct airline booking (e.g., Delta, United), use their dedicated APIs. |
| **Ease of Integration** | **Skyscanner** and **Google Flights** have straightforward REST endpoints and good documentation. |

### Quick Start Example (Python + Skyscanner)

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "YOUR_SKYSCANNER_API_KEY"
BASE_URL = "https://partners.api.skyscanner.net/apiservices"

def search_flights(origin, destination, date):
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/b2b/v1.0/US/USD/en-US/{origin}-{destination}/{date}"
    params = {"apiKey": API_KEY}
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)
    return response.json()

print(search_flights("SFO", "LHR", "2026-08-15"))
```

Replace `API_KEY` with your key from Skyscanner’s developer portal. The response will include flight offers, prices, and booking URLs.
